messages.subject: missing positions by bam2seqz
parts:
Dear Francesco,

I have a list of mutations which are called by MuTect, and I would like to get estimates of local copy number and genotypes of these mutations from Sequenza. However some positions of these mutations are missing after running bam2seqz. I am attaching toy examples of normal and tumor pileup files here. I cannot attach hg19.gc50Base.txt.gz. If it is needed, I can load it into gDocs.

Here is my command line:
>sequenza-utils bam2seqz -q 20 -f sanger -gc hg19.gc50Base.txt.gz -p -n testNormal.pileup.gz -t testTumor.pileup.gz -o test.seqz

The output file has only the first position:
>cat test.seqz
>chromosome      position        base.ref        depth.normal    depth.tumor     depth.ratio     Af      Bf      zygosity.normal GC.percent      good.reads      AB.normal       AB.tumor        tumor.strand
chr1    16269595        C       194     389     2.005   0.79    0       hom     54      386     C       T0.21   T0.58

I went through the code, but couldn't figure out the reason why only the first position is reported. If I remove the first mutation from the original pileup files, the new result reports the new first position from the new file.

Please help me to solve this mystery.

Thanks a lot!

Yan

Hi Yan,

you are right, I can replicate your problem:

sequenza-utils bam2seqz -p -n /Users/lgq442/Downloads/testNormal.pileup.gz -t /Users/lgq442/Downloads/testTumor.pileup.gz -gc  /Users/lgq442/src/sequenza_docker/hg38_gc50.wig.gz

chr1    16269595        C       194     389     2.005   0.79    0       hom     58      386     C       T0.21   T0.58

sequenza-utils lgq442$ sequenza-utils bam2seqz -p -n /Users/lgq442/Downloads/testNormal.pileup.gz -t /Users/lgq442/Downloads/testTumor.pileup.gz -gc  /Users/lgq442/src/sequenza_docker/hg38_gc50.wig.gz -C chr10

chromosome      position        base.ref        depth.normal    depth.tumor     depth.ratio     Af      Bf      zygosity.normal GC.percent      good.reads    AB.normal       AB.tumor        tumor.strand

chr10   22830760        C       352     556     1.58    0.846   0       hom     46      545     C       A0.15:T0.004    A0.561:T0.5

If you try to insert a mutation in chr2 it will show, so it must be some wrong assumption in the loop when changing chromosomes.

sequenza-utils lgq442$ sequenza-utils bam2seqz -p -n /Users/lgq442/Downloads/testNormal.pileup -t /Users/lgq442/Downloads/testTumor.pileup -gc  /Users/lgq442/src/sequenza_docker/hg38_gc50.wig.gz

chromosome      position        base.ref        depth.normal    depth.tumor     depth.ratio     Af      Bf      zygosity.normal GC.percent      good.reads    AB.normal       AB.tumor        tumor.strand

chr1    16269595        C       194     389     2.005   0.79    0       hom     58      386     C       T0.21   T0.58
chr2    22830760        C       352     556     1.58    0.846   0       hom     38      545     C       A0.15:T0.004    A0.561:T0.5

thanks for reporting the bug, I’ll investigate and came back with a fix.

If you need to convert mutect calls into a seqz file you could youse the sequenza-tools snp2seqz program in the latest version


Best

Francesco
